changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwvisitduration AS SELECT vd.id, vd.visit_type, vd.duration_in_minutes, vd.resource_specific, vd.created_by, vd.created_date, vd.last_modified_by, vd.last_modified_date FROM public.visit_duration vd;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwvisitduration TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwvisitduration FROM report_user;
